explanations.text:
●  you ask for a deploy                                  ([the start](main))
  │     You type:  python3 deploy.py --add decompile
  │     The start reads what you asked for: add, all,
  │     diff, list, or remove, and hands it on.
  │
  ●  the tool copies a skill out                          ([the copy](deploy_skill))
  │     It takes one skill folder from compiler/skills
  │     and copies it whole into the skill folders of
  │     claude, droid, and the shared agents place.
  │     An old copy at the target is removed first,
  │     so a deploy never leaves a mix of two versions.
  │
  ●  the tool compares before it copies                   ([the compare](diff_skill))
  │     For one skill it lists what a deploy would change:
  │     a new file, a removed file, a changed file.
  │     Nothing is copied. You look before you leap.
  │
  ●  the tool takes a skill back                          ([the removal](remove_skills))
  │     It deletes the skill's folder from every target
  │     place and says where it removed one.
  │
──────────────
  ●  the small helpers
        [the color check](_supports_color) turns the colored
        output off when the screen cannot show it.
        [the list of sources](available_skills) reads the skill
        folders that sit beside the tool, and
        [the list of installs](installed_skills) reads the ones
        already deployed, so the start can print both.
